findings: Direct differentiation of user linear omega(I) gives J2=[1/Jcore+3V2/A^2]^-1 and therefore a constant J2 if parameters are fixed.

Constrained particle-plus-rotor minimization with Es=V2 P2(c), Is=I0+A c gives omega_s=3V2 c/A and J2=Jcore+A^2/(3V2); core and shears responses add as angular-momentum susceptibilities, so this differs from the user's additive-frequency ansatz unless definitions are specified.
At theta->0 both dE/dtheta and dI/dtheta vanish as sin(theta), but their ratio is finite; the quadratic P2 model has no automatic endpoint singularity.

Finite-difference J2 from Roy E_gamma: 106Cd centers I=18,20,22,24 -> 23.56,25.00,22.60,21.29 hbar^2/MeV; 108Cd I=16,18,20 -> 26.85,25.81,19.14; 110Cd I=16,18,20,22 -> 26.85,40.40,-444.44,90.91. The 110Cd negative/large values are irregular-spacing diagnostics around 1323/1314-keV overlap, not negative physical inertia.
